Woman Alleges Ola Driver Attempted Sexual Assault Near Navi Mumbai Airport

A 23-year-old woman has alleged that an Ola cab driver attempted to sexually assault her near the Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA). The incident reportedly involved the driver molesting and attempting to disrobe the passenger. Police have registered a case and are investigating the allegations. The specific details of the alleged assault and the circumstances leading up to it are under investigation.
